title: $F_X$ is flat over $E_X$
statement:
For finite extensions $E\le F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$ and every scheme $X$, the
extension of scalars $F_X\otimes_{E_X}-\colon\Mod_{E_X}\to\Mod_{F_X}$ along
$E_X\to F_X$ ([def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map], [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]) preserves
finite limits; that is, $F_X$ is flat over $E_X$.

proof.text: Choose the finite E-basis of F. Restrict each coordinate to Q_l and apply finite-dimensional continuity over the complete field Q_l; this does not assume completeness of the algebraic closure. The private point_finiteFree helper constructs the corresponding inverse module morphisms on continuous-map presheaves, proves the two basis identities sectionwise, and transports them through monoidal sheafification.

View the finite free object as the coproduct indexed by ULift (Fin n). Apply the generic scheme_basis_from_point construction in CondensedQbarScalarBasisSections to this point isomorphism. It transports the regular-module copower by the colimit-preserving monoidal point inverse image and proves exactness of extension by flatness of the resulting copower and reflection by the forgetful functor. Evaluate its exactness clause at X.
